description: How long a crypto payment actually takes at BuyUKeSIM and what happens after it confirms. Returns measured confirmation times per coin (median, worst case, share confirmed within two minutes) taken from real orders against public blockchain block timestamps, plus the send delay buyers themselves add, plus how delivery works: it is automatic, triggered by the confirmation, with no human approval step. Use this for "how long does it take", "which coin is fastest", "is delivery instant" and "does someone have to approve my order". Read-only.
name: get_payment_and_delivery_times
